classTerm

packages/deriver/src/Deriver/Evaluator/Term.php:21
final class Term
Public API: explicitly declared with @visibility public.

An immutable expression, partial structure, or symbolic input.

Arrays retain PHP key types and insertion order. A cell denotes a shared PHP reference; an object denotes identity independently of the variable storing it.
